citations.narrative:
There was no Record of Acquisition and Dogs and Cats on Hand (APHIS Form 7005) with the required information
available at the time of inspection. The facility does have a system to document the inventory information for the dogs;
however, they are not currently using the required APHIS Form 7005. The form in use does not include acquisition or
disposition information on the form. The acquisition form (APHIS 7005) is necessary in order to accurately track animals
being used in regulated activities and to ensure all required acquisition information is documented and available to the
APHIS inspector. Each dealer or exhibitor shall use the Record of Acquisition and Dogs and Cats on Hand (APHIS 7005).
Correct by: July 9, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
